metaDescription: Order custom cotton ice scrapers for bulk promotional use. Soft, safe, and branded for winter giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Cotton ice scrapers offer a soft-touch alternative to traditional plastic or metal scrapers, making them ideal for promotional winter campaigns where safety and comfort matter. Unlike rigid scrapers that can scratch windows, cotton versions are gentle on glass while effectively removing light frost. They work well for trade shows, corporate gift bags, or employee appreciation kits. Screen printing or embroidery on the cotton surface provides a clean, durable logo display that stands up to repeated use.
heroAltText: Custom cotton ice scrapers with embroidered logo, soft fabric head for gentle frost removal
